readerCopy.body: One conversation or piece of information can make the next decision impossible to keep vague. When Mercury conjoins the North Node, communication and forward movement meet in the same exchange, allowing a message, application, introduction, contract term, or answer to put a concrete choice where speculation had been. More time may still be needed. The important change is that the decision now has facts, dates, amounts, names, or requirements attached to it.
